=========================================
        MONOPOLY-LK SIMULATION
=========================================

Player 1 : Aggressive Investor
Player 2 : Conservative Banker
Player 3 : Risk Taker
Player 4 : Opportunistic Trader

Each player begins with LKR 30000.

Determining the First Player
Aggressive Investor rolls 8.
Conservative Banker rolls 7.
Risk Taker rolls 8.
Opportunistic Trader rolls 8.
Tie detected between 3 players at 8. Rolling again.
Aggressive Investor rolls 7.
Risk Taker rolls 7.
Opportunistic Trader rolls 11.
Tie detected between 2 players at 7. Rolling again.
Aggressive Investor rolls 7.
Risk Taker rolls 6.

Opportunistic Trader will begin the game.

Turn order:
Opportunistic Trader
Aggressive Investor
Risk Taker
Conservative Banker
